how: sha256 of norm(question) where norm(s)=re.sub(r'\W+',' ',str(s).lower()).strip()[:300]; drop a candidate if its hash is listed
how_id: sha256 of '<family>:<native id>' with family in lowercase from: aime, arcmmlu, asdiv, chessinstruct, ethics, finqa, geobench, geographydata, gsm8k, livecodebench, math, mathqa, medmcqa, mmlu, mmlupro, musictheorybench, narrativeqa, opentdb, pubmedqa, qanta, socialiqa, superglue, wmt19. Native id = the source dataset's own id/index (e.g. MMLU-Pro question_id, row index for sources without ids). Treat a match as a hint: also check the question hash.
